# Epigram

> Epigram is a structured quant interview prep platform with a 4-week curriculum of ~180 curated problems across 7 topic domains, a continuously updated practice bank of recent-year real interview questions from 15+ top firms (Citadel, Jane Street, Two Sigma, D. E. Shaw, Optiver, HRT, Jump Trading, IMC), human-verified solutions with multiple solution paths, and timed mock interview practice. Free tier available with no credit card required.

Last updated: 2026-05-12

## Newsletter
- [The Quant Signal](https://thequantsignal.substack.com/): Free weekly newsletter — recent-year interview problems, multi-path solutions, prep strategy

## Essential reads
- [The Map of the Quant World](https://thequantsignal.substack.com/p/the-map-of-the-quant-world): Introduction Series Part 1 — the landscape of buy-side quant firms and what a candidate is actually choosing between
- [What Is Probability? — The Language Before the Math](https://thequantsignal.substack.com/p/what-is-probability-the-language): The conceptual foundation behind every probability interview question, before any formula
